product.title: Camp & Rescue Kit — Axe + Pliers Bundle
product.body_html:
The two tools that handle 80% of campsite emergencies.

Pair the breaking power of the Desert Breacher with the precision control of the Field Precision pliers. Built for off-road camping trips where you need to chop, build, cut, grip, and improvise — all in one carry.

What's included

  • 1 × Desert Breacher — Multi-function tactical axe (vehicle breach, wood splitting, hammer, claw)
  • 1 × Field Precision — Multi-function pliers (needle-nose, wire cutter, folding knife, bottle opener)
  • 2 × MOLLE-Compatible Sheaths — Belt-loop and pack attachment ready
  • 1 × Survival72 Quick-Reference Card

Why this combo

Most campsite problems break into two categories: brute force (clearing brush, splitting wood, breaking ice on water containers) and precision work (fixing tent rigging, cutting paracord, repairing zippers). One tool for each — no compromise, no missing capability.

Specifications

Total Weight760 g
Combined Materials3CR13 hardened steel (axe head) + Stainless steel (pliers, natural silver finish)
Total Folding Knife Blades2 × 7.2 cm (one in axe handle, one in pliers)
PackagingStandard cardboard box

Save $32 vs buying separately

Single price: $89 (vs $101 if bought as individual items). Free shipping on orders over $35.

Shipping & Returns

Cash on Delivery available across UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, and Oman. 30-day return window from delivery date.
